summary: RPCS3 Core 916 = Core 914 plus the corrections drawn from the build 718 journals (915 was the 4-way comparison witness of Core 914). REWINDBOX_SPURS_RELAXED_STORE_916: with Accurate SPU Reservations off, the PUTLLC of an SPU on a SPURS header line no longer copies its whole 128-byte line over memory: the line is compared with the GETLLAR copy and each changed 16-byte lane is exchanged atomically, so a plain guest store made since GETLLAR fails the PUTLLC and is never overwritten (Assassin's Creed: the lost wake-up of the SPURS kernels behind the 6 s wait of the stop sequence). REWINDBOX_GOW3_MLAA_100_916: the God of War III MLAA bypass (the existing title setting) knows the 01.00 executable, behind a content guard, at a fresh boot. Collection repairs: the stall dump lists the waiters of a lightweight condition from its own queue and the return addresses of waiting PPU threads; CONFIG_LAYERS exports the 21 lever digits (18 before: no capture could be requested); stopped report windows are compact; the report asks once per boot for the bounded PPU region profile when a PPU thread saturates a core. No resolution, precision, frame limit, SPU count or priority, GETLLAR/PUTLLC delay or LLVM option changes; no wait is shortened and no result forced. ABI 30, the 92 exports and the PPU/SPU codegen identities unchanged (one more exact SPUThread.cpp alias, audited). The compile run, the artifact digests and the device status of this Core are recorded in build-utils/rpcs3/core-pin.json and docs/AI_TASK_BOARD.md, not in this summary.
